title: OpenRouter attribution setting (DEC-0065)
description: A product's own OpenRouter app attribution: the product slug (its app is https://passioncode.ai/<product>/), the title OpenRouter shows, and at most two recognized categories. Absent, a product sends no attribution (off by default). The headers go only on requests to https://openrouter.ai for traffic the product originates, never in place of a user's own attribution (openrouter-attribution.md, FAC-SEM-098). The category list is OpenRouter's App Attribution page retrieved 2026-10-12.
